body.statement: For every fixed \(P\in\mathcal M_4\), \(\widehat V\to_PV^{\star}\), \(\sqrt N(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{eff}}-\theta_{\mathrm{PTT}})/\sqrt{\widehat V}\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,1)\), and \(\Pr_P\{\theta_{\mathrm{PTT}}\in[\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{eff}}\pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\widehat V/N}]\}\to1-\alpha\).
body.justification: Pointwise studentization completes the estimator contribution without claiming unsupported uniform inference over tail-escaping laws.
body.gap: Moreau--Kastler (2025, printed page 21) recommends a panel bootstrap, while the proposed efficient correction has no published analytic Wald theory.
body.consumer: The result yields directly reportable confidence intervals for proportional treatment effects under arbitrary within-unit dependence.
